0.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_001
0.description: Let's see what you can put together!

1.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_050
1.description: These should do the trick. Now to see what the Zun think of them...

2.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_051
2.description: Superb work. I'd like to see an amaro try to bite through these beauties!

3.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_100
3.description: I've delivered your gauntlets to the Zun for their appraisal. I can only hope they're as impressed as I was.

6.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ZUNTRAINER00567_000_103
6.description: I wish to speak with the artisan who crafted the gauntlets.

8.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ZUNTRAINER00567_000_105
8.description: First, let me say that my people are not accustomed to wearing metal armor. Our natural scales are hard as steel to begin with, and we do not like to announce ourselves with flashy adornments.

9.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ZUNTRAINER00567_000_106
9.description: We wear only what is essential. The exception to this would be our hide jackets, a memento from those beloved amaro we would remember after their passing.

10.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ZUNTRAINER00567_000_107
10.description: In short, we have no use for bulky protective garments. They would only get in our way.

11.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_108
11.description: Noooooo... I should have known not to get my hopes up.

12.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ZUNTRAINER00567_000_109
12.description: ...Ah, but then I tried using the gloves to handle one of our feistier beasts. She clamped her jaws on my fingers...and I didn't feel a thing.

13.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ZUNTRAINER00567_000_110
13.description: What is more, where I expected the material to be heavy and my movements clumsy, it almost felt as if I was working with bare hands!

14.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ZUNTRAINER00567_000_111
14.description: You tailored the gauntlets to meet our particular needs, and we would acknowledge that effort with suitable payment. That is all I came to say.

15.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_112
15.description: Phew, for a moment there I thought we'd made a mistake. He seemed pleased, didn't he...?

16.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_113
16.description: More than that, he was <hex:021A020203>delighted<hex:021A020103>. I have an eye for artisans, but I didn't realize you were this talented.

17.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_114
17.description: I mean, you've only crafted one new design, and already my business with the Zun is off to a grand start. I might even be able to pay Eismon his wages this year!

18.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_115
18.description: I feel like with you here, bringing back my old employees is not the distant dream it once was. Please say you'll stay and help! Keep your tools at the ready, and I'll find us some more customers to impress!

19.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_166
19.description: Iola is pleased with your efforts. She now considers you the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Iron Bellows' Lifeline<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

20.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_150
20.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, just the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> I wanted to see.

21.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_151
21.description: It's all happening so fast! We've received orders for more of those gauntlets you crafted!

22.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_152
22.description: As I told you, Eismon has a knack for copying existing designs, so I set him loose on the new commissions. After all, he needs to work for his wages!

23.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_EISMON_000_153
23.description: Makes a change from working for nothing...

24.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_154
24.description: And as for you, I need another crafting miracle to impress our next potential client─the Mord!

25.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_155
25.description: Have you been to Amh Araeng? The Mord people have a city there, founded on mining and trading.

26.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_156
26.description: I went myself to do some groundwork, but talking about new wares they might need wasn't high on the agenda.

27.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_157
27.description: No, the Mord seemed more intent on feeding me worms─a local delicacy, or so they said. I could barely choke one down...

28.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_EISMON_000_158
28.description: Really? The taste started to grow on me after a while. I must have eaten a couple of buckets' worth while I was still waiting to get paid.

29.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_159
29.description: I'm so sorry, Eismon. I truly am...

30.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_160
30.description: Well, my visit to the Mord was something of a loss, but mayhap you have some insight that we could build upon?

31.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_161
31.description: The Mord are strikingly similar to the kobolds in appearance. Perhaps the beastmen from the Source make use of something that could prove equally beneficial to their Amh Araeng counterparts...

32.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_Q1_000_000
32.description: What manner of item could the Mord find useful?

36.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_164
36.description: Hm, something to keep their squirmy treats safe?

37.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_165
37.description: I don't know how the Mord will react to that, but I suppose it's worth a try. Make me a worm jar, if you please!

38.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_167
38.description: The Crystarium Deliveries list for Iola has been updated.

39.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_200
39.description: I wish I could do more to revive the Bellows myself, but it's your crafting prowess that will truly make the difference. I'm grateful for your help!

40.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_250
40.description: Thank you! The Mord should be pleased with this!

41.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_251
41.description: Thank you! A container of this quality should keep those wriggling morsels safe and fresh. Not that I'd ever want to eat them...

42.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_300
42.description: ...Right. I've done my part and delivered your work to our potential clients in Mord Souq. Hopefully they like what they see.

43.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_MORDMERCHANT00567_000_301
43.description: This is the forge where the metal jars were made, yes? I wanted to talk to the makers.

44.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_302
44.description: Welcome, welcome! You've come to the right place.

46.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_MORDMERCHANT00567_000_304
46.description: For white earthworms, <hex:021A020203>freshness<hex:021A020103> is best! They fare poorly in sunlight. Death follows soon. They don't keep well.

47.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_EISMON_000_305
47.description: They do taste better fresh from the dirt, that's true.

48.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_306
48.description: What is it with you and worms, Eismon? I'm beginning to think you're a Mord in disguise...

49.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_MORDMERCHANT00567_000_307
49.description: We never tried to store earthworms before, but when we put them in your new jar, they stayed happy in the dark. Safe and squirming and delicious!

50.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_MORDMERCHANT00567_000_308
50.description: And since the jar is made of metal, it doubles as a cooking pot! Over the fire and dinner is served! Whoever made such a wonderful utensil understands the Mord. Understands worms!

51.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_MORDMERCHANT00567_000_309
51.description: If you have any more jars, we would make you an offer. We have much to trade! Coins to buy!

52.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_310
52.description: Another happy customer. It's almost too good to be true. By the way, are <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> one of these worm gourmets, too?

53.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_EISMON_000_311
53.description: It has to be the white ones. They're <hex:021A020203>meatier<hex:021A020103> than other worms, and─

54.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_312
54.description: You've proven your crafting expertise once again, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. And thanks to the stability you've given us, I've managed to convince an old friend to return...

55.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_313
55.description: I'm Colana. You might've heard from Iola, but I was working at the Bellows until...until I couldn't anymore.

56.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_314
56.description: After all Iola's father did for us, abandoning the forge never sat well with me, so I'm glad to have another chance to help the business succeed.

57.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_315
57.description: And we're incredibly glad to have you! You can work with Eismon, crafting stock for all these extra commissions.

58.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_316
58.description: Did you hear that, Eismon? There's plenty of work to be done, so don't think you can take it easy just because I'm back!

59.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_EISMON_000_317
59.description: Now, the reason the white earthworms are meatier has to do with how they survive the arid conditions of Amh Araeng...

61.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_319
61.description: Ahem, anyway! Now all that's left is to convince Sue-Rend to return. I'll scout out a new client, and then you can amaze them with your artisanal brilliance!

62.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_366
62.description: Iola is delighted with your efforts. She now considers you the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Iron Bellows' Hidden Gem<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

63.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_100_350
63.description: I was hoping you'd pay a visit, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

64.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_350
64.description: Those jars you designed are selling like wildfire─we're almost struggling to keep up with demand!

65.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_351
65.description: I have both Colana and Eismon handling the commissions, though, so you and I can turn all our attention to bringing in new business.

66.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_352
66.description: Aye, we have the jars under control! There's a worm cuisine craze sweeping through the Crystarium, and we stand to make a good bit of coin!

67.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_353
67.description: I will never understand the appeal...

68.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_354
68.description: But enough about worms. Let's discuss our next client, shall we? The Ondo! They usually keep to themselves in their underwater settlements, but word from Kholusia says they're willing to engage in trade.

69.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_355
69.description: So Eismon and I went looking for them. We must have trudged along that coastline for days before we finally chanced across a group spearfishing in the shallows. Did you know the Ondo hunt with harpoons fashioned from coral?

70.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_356
70.description: Anyway, I was relieved to find that they were quite amenable to the idea of doing business with the Bellows.

71.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_357
71.description: All we need to do now is to create an item the Ondo might be interested in purchasing. Anything come to mind?

72.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_358
72.description: From what Iola has told you, the Ondo sound strikingly similar to the Sahagin. Perhaps the beastmen from the Source make use of something that could prove equally beneficial to their Kholusian counterparts...

73.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_Q2_000_000
73.description: What manner of item could the Ondo find useful?

76.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_360
76.description: Wouldn't metal flippers be more of a detriment to swimming? Even as you tried to kick forward, the weight would drag you down. Sort of like how my life was progressing before you walked into it...

77.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_361
77.description: Uh-oh, Iola's getting lost in the bad old days. Let's hear another idea─preferably something brilliant that'll snap the boss back to her usual cheery self.

78.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_362
78.description: Ah, an improvement to those coral harpoons I mentioned. I think we're on the right track, but wouldn't the metal rust in the seawater?

79.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_363
79.description: That would depend on the metal used, and I know a few tricks and treatments to ward off rust. Let me worry about that part.

80.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_364
80.description: My dear Colana. Rough edges aside, you always did have a knack for the delicate side of ironwork.

81.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_365
81.description: Well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I can think of no other drawbacks to your trident idea. Craft us a three-pronged masterpiece that will have the Ondo forking out coin and Sue-Rend begging to rejoin our forging family!

82.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_367
82.description: The Crystarium Deliveries list for Iola has been updated.

83.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_400
83.description: Colana's boisterous return has brought a much-needed fire back to our forge. Although I'm afraid Eismon now has to work twice as hard to avoid being burned!

84.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_450
84.description: Excellent work! These will make fine tools for fishing and battle both!

85.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_451
85.description: This is superlative work! The balance and weight are perfect... Why, you could take down a whale with this thing!

86.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_500
86.description: I've delivered your tridents to the Ondo, and now we wait for their verdict. This is always the most exciting─and terrifying─part...

88.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_502
88.description: It certainly is, good sir! Have you come to pay the balance, perchance...?

89.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ONDOFISHERMAN00567_000_503
89.description: So, you are the ones resssponsible for those tridents!

90.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_504
90.description: Oh no! We've angered them! Insulted their ancestors! Mocked their traditional coral craftsmanship!

91.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_505
91.description: Not to worry. That's why you keep a bruiser like me around!

92.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_506
92.description: Er, Colana? I employ you to hammer iron, not our clients...

93.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ONDOFISHERMAN00567_000_507
93.description: Listen well, landwalkers. My people dwell beneath the waves where fire does not burn, and we have no ssskill with forging tools of metal. But we recognize massstery when it is delivered into our very hands!

94.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ONDOFISHERMAN00567_000_508
94.description: Compared to our coral spears, your tridents are ssstronger and sharper, yet show no sign of rusting in the ocean's water. They will ssserve us well in the hunt!

95.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ONDOFISHERMAN00567_000_509
95.description: Such was our joy and sssatisfaction that I felt compelled to cross the seas, ssswim along rivers, and trek over land to heap praise upon their maker.

96.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_510
96.description: Then you should give your thanks to <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> there. It is <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> who first proposed and crafted the piece in question.

97.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ONDOFISHERMAN00567_000_511
97.description: You were the landwalker who came with Alphinaud! It seems your talent in metalwork is the equal of your ssskill in battle. Once more you have our gratitude!

98.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ONDOFISHERMAN00567_000_512
98.description: Master artisan, once more I commend you on your carefully considered work. On behalf of the Ondo, I deliver our endless gratitude!

99.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_ONDOFISHERMAN00567_000_513
99.description: Here is the coin we owe you. I look forward to your next offering.

100.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SUEREND_000_514
100.description: (-Pretentious Voice-)Well, well. Things appear to be going <hex:021A020203>swimmingly<hex:021A020103> for the Bellows these days. In fact, I might almost believe my expertise was no longer required.

101.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_515
101.description: Sue-Rend, you sneaky bastard! How long've you been there...!?

102.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SUEREND_000_516
102.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, was it? I managed a glance at one of the tridents you traded to the Ondo, and I must say, I was quite impressed. Your skills are on par with Iola's father, and he was a man of no small talent.

103.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SUEREND_000_517
103.description: 'Twould reflect badly upon my character were I to accept my former position now, only after business had taken a turn for the better...and yet I cannot pass up this opportunity to work alongside an artisan of your caliber.

104.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_COLANA_000_518
104.description: Or maybe you just can't stand to be away from me. I've got you pegged, Rend!

105.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SUEREND_000_519
105.description: For the moment, I shall content myself with duplicating your wares in an effort to study your techniques. I assume my assistance will not be turned away...?

106.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_520
106.description: This profession does seem to attract the peculiar types. Still, we should be glad to have Sue-Rend back at the forge.

107.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_521
107.description: If you can look past his pretentious manner, you'll find a seasoned craftsman lurking underneath─even my father put stock in Rend's unmatched speed and precision.

108.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_522
108.description: Just look at all we've achieved! With your help, we've secured another market in the Ondo and lured back my other lost employee!

109.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_523
109.description: I cannot thank you enough, yet I would ask that you stay in my employ just a little longer. Rehiring my artisans was a costly endeavor, and we'll need every coin your new creations bring in...

110.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_561
110.description: Iola is overjoyed with your efforts. She now considers you the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Iron Bellows' Ace in the Hole<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

111.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_524
111.description: A new quest continuing the story of the Iron Bellows is now available.

112.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_100_550
112.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Ready to conjure up another fantastic new convenience?

113.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_550
113.description: Look at them. Those three have certainly taken to the work with a passion...which I suppose is to be expected from such veteran artisans.

114.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_551
114.description: Anyway, let's get started on our final project, shall we?

115.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_552
115.description: Our client this time around is the Crystarium's own city guard! I may have mentioned this before, but they've been the only customer that's stuck with us through thick and thin, since the time my father ran the Bellows.

116.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_553
116.description: The problem is, Father would accept the guard's commissions regardless of the losses we stood to make, and that hit to our profit margin became a major factor in the forge's decline.

117.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_554
117.description: I understand why he did what he did: the guards protect us from the sin eaters, and he wanted to outfit them with the best equipment we could provide. A sharper sword, a sturdier shield...the slightest edge might help against the monsters which took my mother from us.

118.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_555
118.description: Now more than ever, the Bellows is in a position to supply the Crystarium's defenders in the way my father would have wanted.

119.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_556
119.description: You remember Nee Marn? They recently told me of a special gemstone which can only be found in Lakeland.

120.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_557
120.description: It seems Voeburtite knights used to carry such a jewel to ward off hostile magicks. A talisman of sorts.

121.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_558
121.description: Well, call it fate, but the city guard's vulnerability to the arcane was the last project to consume my father's attention before he died.

122.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_559
122.description: He wanted to fix the flaw he perceived in their armor, and it falls to me to complete his legacy. As such, the item I would have you craft is already decided: a neckpiece set with the gemstone from Lakeland!

123.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_560
123.description: This is it, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, our final collaboration. I look forward to seeing what masterpiece you devise to protect our soldiers from fell sorcery!

124.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_562
124.description: The Crystarium Deliveries list for Iola has been updated.

125.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_600
125.description: When this project is finished, I imagine you'll be off to help someone new. It's been selfish of me to hoard all your talent for myself.

126.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_650
126.description: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! This just might be the edge a soldier needs to survive the battlefield's less mundane perils!

127.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_651
127.description: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! With these neckpieces, our soldiers will be equipped to face down even the scariest arcane threats!

128.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_700
128.description: I've delivered your work to the city guard, so that's that─our final project together is all but complete. Now we simply wait for the client's verdict...

130.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_702
130.description: That would be me. What can I do for you, Captain Lyna?

131.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_REYNA_000_703
131.description: I came to discuss the new equipment you left with our supply officer.

132.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_REYNA_000_704
132.description: Your father always provided us with the highest quality armaments, but was never satisfied with his attempts to infuse arcane resistance. He would have been proud of this neckpiece you've crafted...

133.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_REYNA_000_705
133.description: We in the guard face danger on a daily basis, and I cannot overstate how much the availability of your potent talisman will benefit morale. I wanted to visit you in person, that I might properly express my gratitude.

134.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_706
134.description: I am pleased to know you are pleased, but I can only accept thanks for the idea. The craftsmanship was all <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> here.

135.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_REYNA_000_707
135.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!? A master artisan? Is there no end to your surprises?

136.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_708
136.description: An impressive talent, isn't it? <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503>'s as skilled as my own father was.

137.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_709
137.description: With their work as a template, I mean to keep the Iron Bellows producing goods of the highest quality.

138.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_710
138.description: As such, I also hope the city guard will continue entrusting their commissions to my forge in the years to come.

139.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_REYNA_000_711
139.description: We would consider it a privilege. Be proud to know that the armaments provided by your family's forge serve an integral part of the Crystarium's defense.

140.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_712
140.description: Did you hear that? An “integral part,” she said. I almost feel like weeping!

141.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_713
141.description: It's been a long road getting the Bellows back on track, and you've stood by me every step of the way. Rest well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─you deserve it!

142.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_100_713
142.description: Iola is thrilled with your efforts. She now considers you the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Iron Bellows' Greatest Weapon<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

143.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_714
143.description: A new quest continuing the story of the Iron Bellows is now available. Speak with Iola as either a blacksmith, armorer, or goldsmith at level 80 or above to undertake the quest.

149.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_810
149.description: With each delivery you make, Iola will come to hold you in higher <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>esteem<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

150.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_811
150.description: Deliver the items Iola needs, and deliver them often to improve your standing with the Iron Bellows!

151.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_820
151.description: The next request will be available from Iola upon reaching level 73 as a blacksmith, armorer, or goldsmith.

152.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_821
152.description: The next request will be available from Iola upon reaching level 75 as a blacksmith, armorer, or goldsmith.

153.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_822
153.description: The next request will be available from Iola upon reaching level 78 as a blacksmith, armorer, or goldsmith.

154.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_830
154.description: Come to check in on us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? As you can see, business is thriving!

155.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_840
155.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

156.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_SYSTEM_000_850
156.description: In order to make deliveries, you must be a blacksmith, armorer, or goldsmith.

157.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_860
157.description: If this new merchandise fails, then the Bellows is done for. I <hex:021A020203>have<hex:021A020103> to make it work...

158.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_900
158.description: We won't fall behind the likes of Katliss, no <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>! The Iron Bellows is here to stay!

159.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_910
159.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I hear you've been working with our own Chora-Zoi on those innovative new tools!

160.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_911
160.description: It was actually me who encouraged her to seek out Master Grenoldt when we learned he was looking to take an apprentice. She's always had potential, and this was the push she needed to truly shine.

161.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_912
161.description: Losing our star artisan was a hit to the Facet's productivity, of course, but Eismon has been picking up the slack for practically nothi─ I mean, for the Crystalline Mean's mandated minimum compensation. So all is well!

162.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER1_00567_IOLA_000_913
162.description: In any case, I hope to organize a joint project between the Iron Bellows and your splendorous tool team in the near future!
